sentences.text:
Rasametti Venkateswara Rao, vs State Of Ap on 23 October,
2019

Author: T. Rajani
Bench: T. Rajani
 Smt. Justice T.Rajani
 Criminal Petition No. 6368 Of 2019
Order:

This criminal petition, under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, is filed by the petitioner-accused seeking for quash of the proceedings against him in crime No. 387 of 2019 of Rajahmundry I Town Police Station, East Godavari District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 270 and 273 IPC and Sections 5 (1) and 22 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production,
Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 (for short, 'the Act of 2003').

Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production,

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the issues raised in this criminal petition are squarely covered by common order of High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh in Criminal Petition Nos. 3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27-08-2018, whereby the Court quashed the proceedings against the petitioners therein for the offences punishable under Indian Penal Code and Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, while permitting the prosecution to proceed with the offences punishable under the provisions of the Act of 2003.
4.

entities.text: High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Indian Penal Code and Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Following the said order and in terms thereof, the proceedings against the petitioner for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 270 and 273 IPC are quashed while permitting the prosecution to proceed with the offences punishable under the provisions of the Act of 2003.
The Registry is directed to annex a copy of the order dated 27-08-2018 in Criminal Petition Nos. 3731 of 2018 and batch to this order.
5. The criminal petition is accordingly partly allowed.

Pending miscellaneous applications, if any,
shall stand closed in consequence.
